---
title: "Install backends"
guide-section: How-to
---

Every backend dasviz draws with is an optional extra, with a long and a short name:

| Extra | Alias | Installs | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dasviz[matplotlib]` | `dasviz[mpl]` | matplotlib | `fig` |
| `dasviz[pyvista]` | `dasviz[pv]` | PyVista (and VTK) | `scene`, `anim` (coming) |
| `dasviz[all]` | | all of the above | |

```bash
pip install "dasviz[pv]"
```

DASCore depends on matplotlib for now, so `dasviz[matplotlib]` installs nothing new today. It is there so that your install keeps working once DASCore no longer does.

## If a backend is missing

The namespaces are there whatever you install; a method checks for its backend when it is called:

```python
>>> patch.scene.patchviewer()
MissingOptionalDependencyError: `patchviewer` requires pyvista, which is not
installed. Install it with: pip install "dasviz[pyvista]"
```

The exception's `install_name` attribute holds the same `dasviz[...]` requirement, for tools which collect what to install.
